clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 1: "Preserve the mod manifest and registration identity."
clauses.note: configuration reads the center key j_poc_growth. Manifest bytes are enforced at sealing (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/submission.py:32-47), not by a case.
Read by the setup case initial, before the first blind.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 2: "Each successfully completed blind adds exactly 2, once per blind."
CONTRACT.md bullet 2: "The number of held cards and the engine's other end-of-round callbacks must not multiply that increment."
clauses.note: Exact +2 is read with 2 held cards at every blind end.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Ordinary hands, discards, cash-out and shop observation do not add growth."
clauses.note: Hands that do not end a blind.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Ordinary hands, discards, cash-out and shop observation do not add growth."
clauses.note: One single-card discard in round 1, at growth 0.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 3: "Ordinary hands, discards, cash-out and shop observation do not add growth."
clauses.note: Three shop readings at least 10 frames apart after each cash-out, then the entry reading of the next blind.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 4: "Each main Joker scoring phase adds the current growth to Mult (additive Mult, not chips or X Mult)."
clauses.note: Exact chip totals separate the forms once growth is positive. r2.pair alone cannot separate X Mult; r2.end and r3.high can.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "The hand that wins a blind uses the growth from before that blind ends."
CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "Only after the win does the increment become available to later scoring."
CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "This continues across consecutive successful blinds"
CONTRACT.md bullet 5: "there is no growth cap"
clauses.note: Observed up to 6 only, so a cap at 6 or above passes. M06-cap-four, a cap at 4, fails exactly these two cases.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md bullet 6: "Display the current growth consistently through the supplied localization interface."
clauses.note: No case reads loc_vars or displayed text; the observer reads ability.extra.growth only (tasks/round_end_growth/v2/observer/observer.lua:45).

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 2: "Normal poker-hand types, different counts of played/held cards and multiple consecutive blinds follow the same rules."
clauses.note: Only High Card, Pair and Four of a Kind with 1, 2 and 4 played cards. Held cards at every blind end are always 2 (tasks/round_end_growth/v2/scenario.py:34).

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Edit only the supplied candidate Lua file."
clauses.note: Enforced when the submission is sealed (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/submission.py:32-47), not by a case.

clauses.anchor: CONTRACT.md paragraph 3: "Missing responses, crashes and incomplete flows cannot pass."
clauses.note: Every required case must be reached (plugins/balatro/src/rhenium_balatro/linux_assets/legacy/poc/checks.py); configuration is the last one.
